name: Udine (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of black and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Udine (a black chevron on white, counterchanged).
history: Municipal flag of Udine, a comune in Friuli Venezia Giulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Udine arms — chevron counterchanged black and white
